name: Day 19 — 週末約會 Date Day

qs.q: What does the wife like most?
What did they also order?
Why does he laugh at her?
ch: She said the same thing last month

gram.d: 最 + adjective/verb = the most: 最喜歡 like most, 最好吃 most delicious, 最重要 most important. Cap it with 之一 for honesty: 最好吃的甜點之一 one of the most delicious. Every recommendation you'll ever give starts here.

readings.title: 買手搖飲 Bubble Tea Run

qs.q: When do drink shops get crowded?
ch: As soon as the weekend arrives

qs.q: What does the wife order?
ch: Pearl milk tea, half sugar, no ice

qs.q: What does the clerk ask?

gram.d: 一 + trigger, 就 + result: 一到週末就很多人 the moment the weekend hits, crowds. 我一到就打給你 I'll call the moment I arrive. Instant cause-and-effect — one of the highest-frequency patterns in real speech.

readings.title: 民間故事：虎姑婆 Folk Tale: Aunt Tiger

qs.q: Who knocked on the door at night?
ch: An old lady claiming to be their great-aunt

qs.q: How did the younger sister escape?
ch: She said she needed the bathroom, ran out, and climbed a tree

qs.q: How do grown-ups use this story today?
ch: To warn kids who won't sleep that Aunt Tiger will come

gram.d: Receiver + 被 (+ doer) + verb: 門被敲了三下 the door got knocked three times, 珍珠被喝完了 the pearls got finished. 被 leans toward things that happen TO you — perfect for spooky stories and office mishaps alike (報告被退回了…).

readings.title: 爆紅的名店 The Shop That Blew Up

qs.q: What is the famous shop selling?
How long is the average wait?
What's the narrator's take?
ch: Tasty is one thing — worth 90 minutes of queueing is another

gram.d: 值得 + verb/noun: 值得排隊 worth the queue, 值得買 worth buying, 值得注意的是… worth noting is… Negate for reviews: 不值得 not worth it. The judgment word that powers every recommendation — and every 雷 warning.

readings.title: 週末買氣回來了 Weekend Spending Returns

qs.q: How does last weekend's foot traffic compare to before the typhoon?
ch: Not reduced — on the contrary, even higher

qs.q: Which categories performed especially well?
What do analysts hope this momentum drives?

gram.t: 不…反而… — not X; on the contrary, Y
gram.d: Sets up an expectation and reverses it: 人潮不減反而更多 crowds didn't shrink — they grew. 他不生氣，反而笑了 instead of anger, he laughed. 反而 flags the twist against expectation — argument writing and news analysis run on it.

dict.py: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī bùdīng.
dict.en: I like pudding the most.

dict.py: Zhè jiā de bīngqílín hěn yǒumíng.
dict.en: This place's ice cream is famous.

dict.py: Wǒmen diǎn yì pán bǐnggān ba.
dict.en: Let's order a plate of cookies.

dict.py: Tiándiǎn lái le!
dict.en: The desserts are here!

dict.py: Zhè shì wǒ chī guò zuì hǎochī de!
dict.en: This is the best I've ever had!

pass.zh: 老公你看菜單！他們的布丁是招牌，冰淇淋有五種。我要冰淇淋跟餅乾，你點布丁，我們可以換著吃，好不好？

qs.q: What is this shop's signature item?
What's the wife's plan?

dict.py: Wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
dict.en: One pearl milk tea, please.

dict.py: Bàntáng qùbīng, xièxiè.
dict.en: Half sugar, no ice, thanks.

dict.zh: 週末的手搖飲店人很多。
dict.py: Zhōumò de shǒuyáoyǐn diàn rén hěn duō.
dict.en: Drink shops are packed on weekends.

dict.py: Tiándù bīngkuài yào zěnme tiáozhěng?
dict.en: How would you like the sweetness and ice?

dict.py: Zhēnzhū yào bú yào jiā dà?
dict.en: Want extra pearls?

pass.zh: 歡迎光臨！先生您好，一杯珍珠奶茶，半糖去冰對嗎？珍珠今天可以免費加大喔！好的，兩杯一共一百一十元，右邊等，叫號碼喔！

qs.q: What's free today?
Where should the customer wait?
ch: On the right, listening for their number

dict.py: Wǒ yào wéitáng shǎobīng.
dict.en: Light sugar, easy ice for me.

dict.py: Duìwǔ yǐjīng pái dào lùkǒu le.
dict.en: The line already stretches to the intersection.

dict.zh: 他們的蛋捲都是現做的。
dict.py: Tāmen de dànjuǎn dōu shì xiànzuò de.
dict.en: Their egg rolls are all made to order.

dict.zh: 虎姑婆的故事，每個孩子都聽過。
dict.py: Hǔ Gūpó de gùshì, měi ge háizi dōu tīng guò.
dict.en: Every kid has heard the Aunt Tiger story.

dict.zh: 現做的要等十五分鐘喔。
dict.py: Xiànzuò de yào děng shíwǔ fēnzhōng ō.
dict.en: Made-to-order takes fifteen minutes.

pass.zh: 排隊的阿姨跟我說：「年輕人，這家我排第三次了！他們的東西都現做，熱熱的最好吃。我孫子最愛，我每個週末都來排。」我問她要排多久，她笑說：「隊伍長沒關係，跟人聊天，時間一下就過了！」

qs.q: How many times has the auntie queued here?
What's her secret to the long wait?
ch: Chatting with people makes time fly

dict.zh: 這家店最近在網路上爆紅。
dict.py: Zhè jiā diàn zuìjìn zài wǎnglù shàng bàohóng.
dict.en: This shop recently went viral online.

dict.zh: 人潮把整條街都塞滿了。
dict.py: Réncháo bǎ zhěng tiáo jiē dōu sāimǎn le.
dict.en: The crowds packed the whole street.

dict.zh: 東區商圈週末特別熱鬧。
dict.py: Dōngqū shāngquān zhōumò tèbié rènào.
dict.en: The East District is especially lively on weekends.

dict.zh: 名店平均要排一個半小時。
dict.py: Míngdiàn píngjūn yào pái yí ge bàn xiǎoshí.
dict.en: The famous shop averages a ninety-minute wait.

dict.zh: 好吃是一回事，值得排隊是另一回事。
dict.py: Hǎochī shì yì huí shì, zhídé páiduì shì lìng yì huí shì.
dict.en: Tasty is one thing — queue-worthy is another.

pass.zh: 美食節目：今天帶大家來看東區最新爆紅的蛋捲名店！老闆說，三個月前只是小攤子，被一個影片帶紅之後，現在每天現做八百份還不夠賣。人潮多到隔壁的店家又愛又恨——生意變好了，可是門口都是別人的隊伍！

qs.q: What made the shop blow up?
Why do neighboring shops love AND hate it?
ch: Business improved, but the doorway is blocked by someone else's queue

dict.zh: 各大商圈的買氣明顯回升。
dict.py: Gè dà shāngquān de mǎiqì míngxiǎn huíshēng.
dict.en: Buying momentum in major districts has clearly rebounded.

dict.py: Réncháo bù jiǎn fǎn'ér gèng duō.
dict.en: Crowds didn't shrink — they grew.

dict.zh: 這股動能有望帶動內需。
dict.py: Zhè gǔ dòngnéng yǒuwàng dàidòng nèixū.
dict.en: This momentum may drive domestic demand.

dict.py: Nèixū zhèngzài jiāsù fùsū.
dict.en: Domestic demand is recovering at speed.

dict.zh: 餐飲類的表現特別亮眼。
dict.py: Cānyǐn lèi de biǎoxiàn tèbié liàngyǎn.
dict.en: Food and beverage performance especially stands out.

pass.zh: 財經快報：主計單位公布，上月零售與餐飲營收雙雙成長，其中甜點與手搖飲成長最快。學者分析，災後的「補償性消費」是主因——悶了兩週，大家更想出門花錢。若買氣延續，內需可望成為第四季經濟成長的主要動力。

qs.q: Which categories grew fastest last month?
What do scholars call the post-disaster spending pattern?

scenarios.intro: Saturday, corner table, one menu, two opinions. Order well and you both win.

them.zh: 你看！他們的冰淇淋有五種！
them.py: Nǐ kàn! Tāmen de bīngqílín yǒu wǔ zhǒng!
them.en: Look! They have five kinds of ice cream!

turns.task: You want pudding — it's their signature.

ans.zh: 我要布丁，是他們的招牌！
ans.py: Wǒ yào bùdīng, shì tāmen de zhāopái!
ans.en: I'm getting the pudding — it's their signature!

them.zh: 那我點冰淇淋！要不要再點一盤餅乾？
them.py: Nà wǒ diǎn bīngqílín! Yào bú yào zài diǎn yì pán bǐnggān?
them.en: Then I'll get ice cream! Should we add a plate of cookies?

turns.task: Yes — order the cookies to share.

ans.zh: 好啊，點一盤餅乾，我們一起吃！
ans.py: Hǎo a, diǎn yì pán bǐnggān, wǒmen yìqǐ chī!
ans.en: Sure — one plate of cookies to share!

them.zh: 哇——你吃一口看看，這個冰淇淋！
them.py: Wā — nǐ chī yì kǒu kànkan, zhège bīngqílín!
them.en: Whoa — try a bite of this ice cream!

turns.task: Try it — it really is delicious.

ans.zh: 嗯！真的很好吃！
ans.py: Ēn! Zhēn de hěn hǎochī!
ans.en: Mm! It really is delicious!

them.zh: 對吧！這是我吃過最好吃的冰淇淋！
them.py: Duì ba! Zhè shì wǒ chī guò zuì hǎochī de bīngqílín!
them.en: Right?! This is the best ice cream I've ever had!

turns.task: Tease her — she said the same thing last month.

ans.zh: 哈哈，你上個月也說一樣的話！
ans.py: Hāhā, nǐ shàng ge yuè yě shuō yíyàng de huà!
ans.en: Haha — you said the exact same thing last month!

them.zh: 每一家都是最好吃的，不行嗎？
them.py: Měi yì jiā dōu shì zuì hǎochī de, bùxíng ma?
them.en: Every shop can be the best — is that not allowed?

turns.task: Concede sweetly — desserts with her are always the best.

ans.zh: 行！跟你一起吃的甜點，都是最好吃的！
ans.py: Xíng! Gēn nǐ yìqǐ chī de tiándiǎn, dōu shì zuì hǎochī de!
ans.en: Allowed! Any dessert with you is the best one!

scenarios.intro: The counter, the menu wall, the sacred questions: sweetness and ice. This is the most-run dialogue in all of Taiwan — own it.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！請問要點什麼？
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín! Qǐngwèn yào diǎn shénme?
them.en: Welcome! What would you like?

turns.task: Two pearl milk teas.

ans.zh: 你好，我要兩杯珍珠奶茶。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào liǎng bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
ans.en: Hi — two pearl milk teas, please.

them.zh: 好的！甜度冰塊怎麼調整？
them.py: Hǎo de! Tiándù bīngkuài zěnme tiáozhěng?
them.en: Sure! How about the sweetness and ice?

turns.task: Both half sugar, no ice.

ans.zh: 兩杯都半糖去冰。
ans.py: Liǎng bēi dōu bàntáng qùbīng.
ans.en: Both half sugar, no ice.

them.zh: 珍珠今天可以免費加大，要嗎？
them.py: Zhēnzhū jīntiān kěyǐ miǎnfèi jiā dà, yào ma?
them.en: Extra pearls are free today — want that?

turns.task: Yes for one cup — your wife loves pearls.

ans.zh: 一杯要，我老婆最愛珍珠！
ans.py: Yì bēi yào, wǒ lǎopó zuì ài zhēnzhū!
ans.en: For one cup, yes — my wife loves pearls!

them.zh: 沒問題！兩杯一共一百一十元。
them.py: Méi wèntí! Liǎng bēi yígòng yìbǎi yīshí yuán.
them.en: You got it! Two cups, one hundred ten total.

turns.task: Pay and ask about how long the wait is.

ans.zh: 好，這是一百一十元。請問要等多久？
ans.py: Hǎo, zhè shì yìbǎi yīshí yuán. Qǐngwèn yào děng duōjiǔ?
ans.en: Here's one ten. How long is the wait?

them.zh: 大概五分鐘，右邊等，會叫號碼喔！
them.py: Dàgài wǔ fēnzhōng, yòubiān děng, huì jiào hàomǎ ō!
them.en: About five minutes — wait on the right, we'll call your number!

turns.task: Thank them and step aside.

ans.zh: 謝謝！我在旁邊等。
ans.py: Xièxiè! Wǒ zài pángbiān děng.
ans.en: Thanks! I'll wait over here.

scenarios.who: 排隊的阿姨 Auntie in Line
scenarios.intro: Ninety minutes of queue, one chatty auntie beside you. This is where real listening skills are forged.

them.zh: 年輕人，你們也來排這家喔？很有名喔！
them.py: Niánqīngrén, nǐmen yě lái pái zhè jiā ō? Hěn yǒumíng ō!
them.en: You kids queueing here too? It's famous!

turns.task: Yes — you heard everything is made to order.

ans.zh: 對啊，聽說他們的東西都是現做的！
ans.py: Duì a, tīngshuō tāmen de dōngxi dōu shì xiànzuò de!
ans.en: Yeah — we heard everything's made to order!

them.zh: 沒錯！熱熱的最好吃！我排第三次了！
them.py: Méicuò! Rè rè de zuì hǎochī! Wǒ pái dì sān cì le!
them.en: That's right! Best when hot! This is my third time queueing!

turns.task: Third time?! Ask how long the line usually takes.

ans.zh: 第三次？！請問隊伍通常要排多久？
ans.py: Dì sān cì?! Qǐngwèn duìwǔ tōngcháng yào pái duōjiǔ?
ans.en: Third time?! How long does the line usually take?

them.zh: 一個半小時跑不掉！可是跟人聊天，時間一下就過了！
them.py: Yí ge bàn xiǎoshí pǎo bú diào! Kěshì gēn rén liáotiān, shíjiān yíxià jiù guò le!
them.en: Ninety minutes minimum! But chat with people and time flies!

turns.task: Laugh — chatting with her, ninety minutes will pass in no time.

ans.zh: 哈哈，跟阿姨聊天，一個半小時一下就過了！
ans.py: Hāhā, gēn āyí liáotiān, yí ge bàn xiǎoshí yíxià jiù guò le!
ans.en: Haha — chatting with you, ninety minutes will be gone in a flash!

them.zh: 你嘴真甜！買回去給誰吃？
them.py: Nǐ zuǐ zhēn tián! Mǎi huíqù gěi shéi chī?
them.en: Sweet talker! Who are you buying for?

turns.task: For your wife — and to bring to coworkers on Monday.

ans.zh: 給我老婆，星期一也帶去公司給同事吃。
ans.py: Gěi wǒ lǎopó, xīngqíyī yě dài qù gōngsī gěi tóngshì chī.
ans.en: For my wife — and I'll bring some to my coworkers Monday.

them.zh: 你人真好！輪到我了——年輕人，慢慢排喔！
them.py: Nǐ rén zhēn hǎo! Lún dào wǒ le — niánqīngrén, mànmàn pái ō!
them.en: How thoughtful! My turn's up — enjoy the rest of the queue, kids!

turns.task: Wish her a good weekend as she goes.

ans.zh: 阿姨再見，週末愉快！
ans.py: Āyí zàijiàn, zhōumò yúkuài!
ans.en: Bye, auntie — have a great weekend!

scenarios.intro: Xiao Chen saw your queue photo and has theories about internet fame, crowds, and egg-roll economics. Debate him.

them.zh: 你們去排那家蛋捲喔？我看它上個月才爆紅的！
them.py: Nǐmen qù pái nà jiā dànjuǎn ō? Wǒ kàn tā shàng ge yuè cái bàohóng de!
them.en: You queued for that egg-roll place? It only went viral last month!

turns.task: True — one video and now the crowds pack the whole street.

ans.zh: 對啊，一個影片就爆紅，現在人潮把整條街都塞滿了。
ans.py: Duì a, yí ge yǐngpiàn jiù bàohóng, xiànzài réncháo bǎ zhěng tiáo jiē dōu sāimǎn le.
ans.en: Yep — one video and it blew up. Now the crowds pack the entire street.

them.zh: 這種名店都是一陣子而已啦，半年就沒人了。
them.py: Zhè zhǒng míngdiàn dōu shì yí zhènzi éryǐ la, bànnián jiù méi rén le.
them.en: These famous shops are just a phase — empty in six months.

turns.task: Push back — some last: if the product is solid, virality becomes a loyal base.

ans.zh: 不一定喔。東西真的好的話，爆紅會變成老客人，有的名店一開就是十年。
ans.py: Bù yídìng ō. Dōngxi zhēn de hǎo dehuà, bàohóng huì biànchéng lǎo kèrén, yǒude míngdiàn yì kāi jiùshì shí nián.
ans.en: Not necessarily — if the product's genuinely good, virality turns into regulars. Some famous shops run ten years.

them.zh: 好啦有道理。欸，商圈的店租一定漲翻了吧？
them.py: Hǎo la yǒu dàolǐ. Éi, shāngquān de diànzū yídìng zhǎng fān le ba?
them.en: Fair point. Hey — rents in that district must be soaring, right?

turns.task: Probably — crowds drive the whole district's business, and rent follows.

ans.zh: 應該是，人潮會帶動整個商圈的生意，店租當然跟著漲。
ans.py: Yīnggāi shì, réncháo huì dàidòng zhěngge shāngquān de shēngyì, diànzū dāngrán gēnzhe zhǎng.
ans.en: Probably — crowds drive the whole district's business, so rents follow.

them.zh: 所以你到底排了沒有？蛋捲呢？
them.py: Suǒyǐ nǐ dàodǐ pái le méiyǒu? Dànjuǎn ne?
them.en: So did you actually queue or not? Where are the egg rolls?

turns.task: Confess — you looked at the ninety-minute line and bought bubble tea instead.

ans.zh: 哈哈沒有，我看了那個一個半小時的隊伍，就去買手搖飲了。
ans.py: Hāhā méiyǒu, wǒ kàn le nàge yí ge bàn xiǎoshí de duìwǔ, jiù qù mǎi shǒuyáoyǐn le.
ans.en: Haha, nope — one look at the ninety-minute line and I went for bubble tea instead.

them.zh: 哈哈哈標準！那星期一的蛋捲呢？你跟同事說了耶！
them.py: Hāhāhā biāozhǔn! Nà xīngqíyī de dànjuǎn ne? Nǐ gēn tóngshì shuō le yē!
them.en: Classic! But what about Monday's egg rolls? You promised the coworkers!

turns.task: Problem for future you — Monday's plan: queue at opening time.

ans.zh: 星期一的我再想辦法——計畫是：一開店就去排！
ans.py: Xīngqíyī de wǒ zài xiǎng bànfǎ — jìhuà shì: yì kāi diàn jiù qù pái!
ans.en: That's future me's problem — the plan: queue the moment they open!

scenarios.intro: Saturday night message from the south. Mr. Wang read the same recovery news you did — and he's connecting it to your deal.

them.zh: 週末愉快！看到新聞了嗎？各大商圈的買氣都回來了！
them.py: Zhōumò yúkuài! Kàndào xīnwén le ma? Gè dà shāngquān de mǎiqì dōu huílái le!
them.en: Happy weekend! Seen the news? Buying momentum is back in all the big districts!

turns.task: You saw — crowds didn't shrink after the typhoon; on the contrary, they grew.

ans.zh: 看到了！颱風過後人潮不減反而更多，恢復得比想像中快。
ans.py: Kàndào le! Táifēng guòhòu réncháo bù jiǎn fǎn'ér gèng duō, huīfù de bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng kuài.
ans.en: I did! Post-typhoon crowds didn't shrink — they grew. Recovery's faster than expected.

them.zh: 高雄也是！專家說這叫「補償性消費」，悶久了就想花錢，哈哈！
them.py: Gāoxióng yě shì! Zhuānjiā shuō zhè jiào "bǔchángxìng xiāofèi", mèn jiǔ le jiù xiǎng huāqián, hāhā!
them.en: Kaohsiung too! Experts call it 'compensatory consumption' — cooped up too long, people want to spend, haha!

turns.task: Agree — and this momentum may drive domestic demand's recovery into Q4.

ans.zh: 沒錯，這股動能有望帶動內需復甦，一路旺到第四季。
ans.py: Méicuò, zhè gǔ dòngnéng yǒuwàng dàidòng nèixū fùsū, yílù wàng dào dì sì jì.
ans.en: Exactly — this momentum could drive domestic demand's recovery right through Q4.

them.zh: 內需好，政府的預算也會鬆，對我們的案子是好事！
them.py: Nèixū hǎo, zhèngfǔ de yùsuàn yě huì sōng, duì wǒmen de ànzi shì hǎoshì!
them.en: Strong domestic demand loosens government budgets too — good for our project!

turns.task: Agree — economic recovery plus the October expo makes the timing excellent.

ans.zh: 同意，經濟復甦加上十月的展覽，我們的時機非常好。
ans.py: Tóngyì, jīngjì fùsū jiāshàng shí yuè de zhǎnlǎn, wǒmen de shíjī fēicháng hǎo.
ans.en: Agreed — the recovery plus October's expo makes our timing excellent.

them.zh: 對了，下下週就簽約了，你們高鐵跟飯店都訂好了吧？
them.py: Duìle, xiàxià zhōu jiù qiānyuē le, nǐmen gāotiě gēn fàndiàn dōu dìng hǎo le ba?
them.en: By the way — signing is the week after next. Your HSR and hotel are all booked?

turns.task: All booked — arriving 10:30 on the ninth; dinner's on you two that night.

ans.zh: 都訂好了，九號早上十點半到。那天晚上讓我們請客！
ans.py: Dōu dìng hǎo le, jiǔ hào zǎoshàng shí diǎn bàn dào. Nà tiān wǎnshàng ràng wǒmen qǐngkè!
ans.en: All booked — we arrive 10:30 on the ninth. And dinner that night is on us!

them.zh: 哈哈那我不客氣了！高雄最好吃的海鮮，我帶路！
them.py: Hāhā nà wǒ bú kèqì le! Gāoxióng zuì hǎochī de hǎixiān, wǒ dàilù!
them.en: Haha, then I won't be polite! Kaohsiung's best seafood — I'll lead the way!

turns.task: Deal — he picks the place, you pick up the bill. See him on the ninth.

ans.zh: 一言為定！你選店，我買單，九號見！
ans.py: Yì yán wéi dìng! Nǐ xuǎn diàn, wǒ mǎidān, jiǔ hào jiàn!
ans.en: It's a deal! You pick the place, I grab the bill — see you on the ninth!

x: 這家的冰淇淋很有名。
Zhè jiā de bīngqílín hěn yǒumíng.
This place's ice cream is famous.
vocab.n: 冰 ice family reunion: 冰箱, 剉冰 shaved ice, 霜淇淋 soft serve (the convenience-store kind).

x: 我們點一盤餅乾吧。
Wǒmen diǎn yì pán bǐnggān ba.
Let's order a plate of cookies.
vocab.n: 餅 flat-baked + 乾 dry. Covers sweet cookies AND savory crackers. 鳳梨酥 pineapple cakes are their famous cousin.

x: 吃完飯，要不要點甜點？
Chī wán fàn, yào bú yào diǎn tiándiǎn?
Shall we order dessert after the meal?
vocab.n: 甜 sweet + 點 snack. 飯後甜點 after-dinner dessert. The claim 甜點是另一個胃 — dessert goes to a separate stomach — is settled science in Taiwan.

x: 我最喜歡吃布丁。
Wǒ zuì xǐhuān chī bùdīng.
I like pudding best.
vocab.n: Loanword from 'pudding' — in Taiwan it means the caramel custard kind. 統一布丁 is a national childhood memory.

x: 週末的手搖飲店人很多。
Zhōumò de shǒuyáoyǐn diàn rén hěn duō.
Drink shops are packed on weekends.
vocab.n: 手 hand + 搖 shake + 飲 drink: the whole bubble-tea category. Taiwan invented it and drinks a billion cups a year. Also 手搖杯.

x: 珍珠要不要加大？
Zhēnzhū yào bú yào jiā dà?
Want extra pearls?
vocab.n: Literally 'pearl' — the tapioca balls in 珍珠奶茶. Small ones are 波霸's little sibling; 波霸奶茶 = big-pearl milk tea.

x: 我要半糖去冰。
Wǒ yào bàntáng qùbīng.
Half sugar, no ice for me.
vocab.n: The sweetness scale: 正常糖 full, 少糖 less, 半糖 half, 微糖 light, 無糖 none. Locals treat your default as a personality test.

x: 兩杯都去冰，謝謝。
Liǎng bēi dōu qùbīng, xièxiè.
No ice in both, thanks.
vocab.n: 去 remove + 冰. The ice scale: 正常冰 full, 少冰 less, 微冰 light, 去冰 none, 完全去冰 REALLY none. More drink, same price — the 去冰 economist's choice.

x: 我現在都喝微糖，比較健康。
Wǒ xiànzài dōu hē wéitáng, bǐjiào jiànkāng.
I do light sugar now — healthier.
vocab.n: 微 slight: roughly 30% sweetness. 微 works everywhere: 微冰 light ice, 微波 microwave, 微笑 slight smile — you know that one.

x: 我要微糖少冰。
Wǒ yào wéitáng shǎobīng.
Light sugar, easy ice.
vocab.n: 少 reduced: about 70% of standard ice. Combine freely with the sugar scale — 微糖少冰 is one of Taiwan's most-spoken four-character phrases.

x: 隊伍已經排到路口了。
Duìwǔ yǐjīng pái dào lùkǒu le.
The line stretches to the intersection.
vocab.n: The noun behind 排隊: 隊伍很長 long line. Also military/parade ranks — 整齊的隊伍 orderly ranks. Dual-register bonus word.

x: 他們的蛋捲都是現做的。
Tāmen de dànjuǎn dōu shì xiànzuò de.
Their egg rolls are made to order.
vocab.n: 現 on-the-spot + 做: 現做現賣 made and sold fresh. The 現-series: 現煮 fresh-brewed, 現榨 fresh-squeezed, 現炸 fresh-fried — menu magnets all.

x: 名店平均要排一個半小時。
Míngdiàn píngjūn yào pái yí ge bàn xiǎoshí.
The famous shop averages a ninety-minute wait.
vocab.n: 名 famous + 店: 排隊名店 the queue-famous shop, 百年名店 century-old institution. Guidebook and food-show vocabulary.

x: 人潮把整條街都塞滿了。
Réncháo bǎ zhěng tiáo jiē dōu sāimǎn le.
The crowds packed the whole street.
vocab.n: 人 people + 潮 tide: humanity as ocean. 人潮洶湧 surging crowds; 錢潮 the money tide that follows — 人潮就是錢潮, retail's favorite proverb.

x: 東區商圈週末特別熱鬧。
Dōngqū shāngquān zhōumò tèbié rènào.
The East District is extra lively on weekends.
vocab.n: 商 commerce + 圈 circle: 西門町商圈, 信義商圈. News unit for retail health — 商圈復甦 district recovery.

vocab.e: to go viral, blow up overnight
x: 這家店最近在網路上爆紅。
Zhè jiā diàn zuìjìn zài wǎnglù shàng bàohóng.
This shop just went viral online.
vocab.n: 爆 explode + 紅 popular: 一夕爆紅 famous overnight. 紅 alone = popular (他很紅); 爆 makes it detonate. Sibling: 爆款 a viral product.

x: 這股動能有望帶動內需。
Zhè gǔ dòngnéng yǒuwàng dàidòng nèixū.
This momentum may drive domestic demand.
vocab.n: 內 internal + 需 demand: the economy's home engine, versus 外銷 exports. 內需市場 domestic market — GDP-report regular.

x: 各大商圈的買氣明顯回升。
Gè dà shāngquān de mǎiqì míngxiǎn huíshēng.
Buying momentum has clearly rebounded.
vocab.n: 買 buy + 氣 vapor/energy: how hot the buying mood runs. 買氣旺 brisk sales, 買氣冷 frozen wallets. Retail journalism's thermometer.

x: 人潮帶動整個商圈的生意。
Réncháo dàidòng zhěngge shāngquān de shēngyì.
Crowds drive the whole district's business.
vocab.n: 帶 lead + 動 move: one thing pulling others along. 帶動成長 spur growth, 帶動風潮 start a trend — cause-and-effect for economies.

x: 內需正在加速復甦。
Nèixū zhèngzài jiāsù fùsū.
Domestic demand is recovering at speed.
vocab.n: 復 again + 甦 revive: 經濟復甦 economic recovery, 景氣復甦 the upturn. Stronger than 恢復 — this one implies coming back to life.

slang.e: to make a 'pilgrimage' to a famous spot
x: 這家爆紅的名店，我們也來朝聖一下！
Zhè jiā bàohóng de míngdiàn, wǒmen yě lái cháoshèng yíxià!
This viral shop — we're here for the pilgrimage too!
slang.n: Literally religious pilgrimage, repurposed for fan visits: a famous shop, a filming location, a legendary arcade. 來朝聖的 = here because it's famous.

x: 我吃很飽了，可是甜點胃永遠有空間！
Wǒ chī hěn bǎo le, kěshì tiándiǎn wèi yǒngyuǎn yǒu kōngjiān!
I'm stuffed — but the dessert stomach always has room!
slang.n: The theory that desserts digest in a separate, always-empty stomach. 甜點是另一個胃 — the full sentence version. Scientifically dubious, socially undefeated.

x: 全糖加珍珠再加布丁？你根本螞蟻人！
Quán táng jiā zhēnzhū zài jiā bùdīng? Nǐ gēnběn mǎyǐrén!
Full sugar, pearls, AND pudding? You're a total ant person!
slang.n: 螞蟻 ants love sugar; a 螞蟻人 orders 全糖 without shame. Self-deprecating badge of honor in dessert-loving Taiwan.

slang.e: to get 'burned' — infected with wanting something
x: 看了那個蛋捲影片，我完全被燒到了。
Kàn le nàge dànjuǎn yǐngpiàn, wǒ wánquán bèi shāodào le.
That egg-roll video totally lit the must-have fire in me.
slang.n: 燒 burn: when a review/video ignites your need to buy or try. 被燒到 caught the flame; 燒一下大家 = spreading the temptation on purpose. 滅火 (dousing) = a bad review that saves your wallet.

x: 排不到就算了，我們佛系排隊，排到是緣分。
Pái bú dào jiù suàn le, wǒmen fóxì páiduì, pái dào shì yuánfèn.
If we miss out, so be it — we queue Buddha-style; getting in is destiny.
slang.n: 佛 Buddha + 系 style: desiring nothing, accepting all outcomes. 佛系購物, 佛系戀愛, 佛系人生. Japan-born meme, fully at home in Taiwan.
